parameters.formDescription: Upload a PDF bank statement or invoice. You get back reconciled rows as CSV, plus a flag on anything that does not add up.

nodes.name: OCR (scanned only)
nodes.notes: Only fires for scanned PDFs. Swap for any OCR provider - the contract is text in, text out.

nodes.name: Batch rows (page-sized)
nodes.notes: Batching keeps LLM context small. Accuracy on late pages collapses without this.
